description: Index IX_N (N ASC) and IX_NDESC (N DESC) over F hold N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70 (40 twice). For each index and each operator < <= = >= > <> and each key 5, 35, 40, 80 (below the range, in a gap, a duplicate, above the range): fresh table-type recordset, set the Index, Seek, read NoMatch, BOF, EOF, ID and N; MoveNext and read; MovePrevious twice and read. Asks which row each operator selects when the key is absent or beyond either end of an ascending and a descending index, and the following moves in both directions. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
